Assets

AS01-11/26 Tender No. 26173 The Supply and Laying of Asphalt for Road Resurfacing

File Ref: 12345 – 26/123456

Responsible Officer: Director Assets

Issue

To consider Tender No. 26173 for the supply and laying of asphalt for road resurfacing.

Background

Tender No. 26173 was advertised on 1 August 2026 and closed on 26 August 2026. Three submissions were received.

Recommendation

That Council:-

1. ACCEPTS Tender No. 26173 submitted by Example Asphalt Pty Ltd for The Supply and Laying of Asphalt for Road Resurfacing for a period of three years at an estimated annual value of $2,400,000 (excl GST); and

2. AUTHORISES the Chief Executive Officer to execute the contract.

AS02-11/26 Wanneroo Road / Joondalup Drive Intersection Upgrade - Black Spot Funding

Issue

To consider a budget variation to accept State Black Spot funding for the intersection upgrade in Wanneroo.

Recommendation

That Council APPROVES BY ABSOLUTE MAJORITY a budget variation of $350,000 for the Wanneroo Road / Joondalup Drive intersection upgrade, funded by a State Black Spot grant.
